title: Music Box Is Now Live
content:
music.yuri1.com

YURI NO1's Music Box is now live.

It offers a different kind of music experience, bringing stories and music together through tracks inspired by YURI NO1's works and characters.

They may not be the most perfect songs.

But each one is unique, and each is a track that has been chosen to remain and be shared.

Welcome to YURI NO1 Music.

Enjoy listening.
